clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Discuss every dose change with a Consultant. Recovery, previous dose and prior reductions must be reviewed. Source percentages are displayed as guidance without an unsupported absolute dose calculation.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00222 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source reconciled in 0.84.23; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation pending.

indications.description: Maintenance of locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC other than predominantly squamous histology, with no progression immediately after platinum-based chemotherapy.
Second-line treatment of locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC other than predominantly squamous histology.

treatment.schedule_summary: Pemetrexed 500 mg/m² IV over 10 minutes on Day 1, every 21 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

action.recommendation: Resolve absent required vitamins before pemetrexed: at least five folate doses in the preceding seven days and B12 in the preceding week. Continue folate throughout and for 21 days after the last dose; B12 every three cycles thereafter.

rules.explanation: Resolve absent required vitamins before pemetrexed: at least five folate doses in the preceding seven days and B12 in the preceding week. Continue folate throughout and for 21 days after the last dose; B12 every three cycles thereafter.

action.recommendation: Confirm rash prophylaxis equivalent to dexamethasone 4 mg orally twice daily the day before, day of and day after pemetrexed. Reconcile into one steroid prescription with any antiemetic plan.

rules.explanation: Confirm rash prophylaxis equivalent to dexamethasone 4 mg orally twice daily the day before, day of and day after pemetrexed. Reconcile into one steroid prescription with any antiemetic plan.

action.recommendation: Check medicine, dose, renal function and timing. At CrCl 45–79, avoid NSAIDs and high-dose aspirin for 2 days before, treatment day and 2 days after pemetrexed; long-half-life NSAIDs require at least 5 days before, treatment day and at least 2 days after. If necessary coadministration cannot be avoided, monitor closely for marrow and GI toxicity. High NSAID/aspirin doses also warrant caution with normal renal function. Do not stop prescribed medicines without a clinician plan.

source.section: 4.5; conditional advice, not autonomous stop-date or renal-band calculation

rules.explanation: Check medicine, dose, renal function and timing. At CrCl 45–79, avoid NSAIDs and high-dose aspirin for 2 days before, treatment day and 2 days after pemetrexed; long-half-life NSAIDs require at least 5 days before, treatment day and at least 2 days after. If necessary coadministration cannot be avoided, monitor closely for marrow and GI toxicity. High NSAID/aspirin doses also warrant caution with normal renal function. Do not stop prescribed medicines without a clinician plan.

eligibility: NCCP00222a maintenance after platinum chemotherapy without immediate progression, or NCCP00222b second-line advanced NSCLC.
NSCLC other than predominantly squamous histology.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal and liver profile.
Repeat FBC, renal and liver profile before every cycle.
Review interval toxicity, prior reductions, vitamin adherence, steroid plan and interacting medicines.
Disease monitoring follows the Consultant treatment plan; no fixed scan interval is encoded.
dose_modifications: NCCP current-count Table1, renal/hepatic Table2 and adverse-event Table3 reconciled with explicit source pages.
All changes require Consultant discussion; percentage guidance is conditional on recovery and prior-dose review.
Bleeding footnote: CTC v2.0 NCI1998 ≥grade2; other adverse-event grading edition unspecified.

supportive_care.mapping_source: NCCP00222 v5 page4 and NCIS Medical Oncology antiemetics V8 2025
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Standalone pemetrexed is low emetogenic risk; this is not platinum or immunotherapy combination maintenance.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk
additional_supportive_care: Folic acid 350–1000 micrograms daily: ≥5 doses in the week before first pemetrexed, throughout and 21 days after the last dose.
Vitamin B12 hydroxocobalamin 1000 micrograms IM in the preceding week and every three cycles; later injections may be on treatment day.
Dexamethasone equivalent 4 mg orally twice daily day before, day of and day after; one reconciled prescription, no double steroid course.
NSAID/aspirin and renal interaction review; follow the current SmPC and local policy.

treatment_phases.label: Standalone pemetrexed every 21 days
treatment_phases.duration_note: No fixed cycle count; continue until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity under the Consultant plan.
